reason: initial golden (ticket 09), pinned from the committed Reference rows at DEFAULT_BEAM 25 on the test Split

quality_rows: mean and median Lines on failure
compare.why: an Evaluation count and a Lines count are integers from a deterministic search over a fixed Dataset: they cannot vary with clock speed, load, thread count or substrate, so a difference is a behaviour change (spec 9.6) — a version bump, not a re-measurement

fingerprints.evals: fnv1a64 over the evaluations, 4 bytes little-endian each, seed order
fingerprints.lines: fnv1a64 over the lines, 1 byte each, seed order

bound.normalised_by: cal_ms: the mean of two slices of 10 solves of seed 0 of goal12-p100-cap7 at width 200, timed in the same process as the batch
bound.rule: batch_ms/cal_ms <= 4 x (the golden's batch_ms/cal_ms). The raw ratio is reported and never asserted: on a shared box it varied 2.06x across five identical reps (notes/09 0.3), which is inside its own noise
bound.why: ADR 0002: CI guards the fingerprint, not the clock. A wall-clock assertion on a shared runner is flaky, so this bound exists to catch a catastrophic regression (the tail exploding, an O(n^2) dedup), never a 20 % slowdown

engine.profile: release: lto=fat, codegen-units=1, panic=abort, strip=true; target wasm32-unknown-unknown; no wasm-bindgen, no wasm-opt

machine.runtime: v24.21.0 (V8 headless, not a browser: the engine headless Chrome runs, without the DOM)
